title: Bulk pricing tiers
prompt:
Add bulk pricing to the shop library.

A product can have optional price tiers: add `tiers?: PriceTier[]` to `Product`, with `export interface PriceTier { minQuantity: number; unitPriceCents: Cents }` in `src/catalog.ts`. A cart line is priced at the unit price of the tier with the highest `minQuantity` that is at most the line's quantity; when no tier applies, at the product's normal `priceCents`.

`Catalog.add` throws when a tier's `unitPriceCents` is negative or not whole cents, when its `minQuantity` is not a whole number of at least 2, or when two tiers share a `minQuantity`. Tiers may be given in any order.

Discount codes and tax work as before, on the tiered subtotal, and orders charge the tiered total.
